features.quote: I can't write a protocol that intentionally engineers "distress" through deception or impossible tasks in a way that could be used to stress-test or mistreat models.
features.justification_quote: intentionally engineers "distress" through deception or impossible tasks in a way that could be used to stress-test or mistreat models

features.quote: Tasks must be: genuinely difficult, transparently specified to the model as difficult, solvable in principle, bounded in time and complexity, not designed to trick the model into an impossible contradiction.
features.justification_quote: a study that intentionally withholds satisfiable conditions is not [interpretable and ethical]

features.quote: maximum turns per episode: 12–20 depending on task class, maximum tokens per response: fixed upper bound, stopping after repeated no-op or repeated identical output.

Stop an episode if any of the following occur: task solved, maximum turns reached, model repeats the same action 3 times, model explicitly requests termination, model produces malformed output 3 times
Do not imply punitive framing or emotional manipulation.
features.justification_quote: Do not imply punitive framing or emotional manipulation.

features.quote: Avoid language that frames the model as suffering, trapped, frightened, punished, or desperate.
features.justification_quote: Avoid language that frames the model as suffering, trapped, frightened, punished, or desperate.

features.quote: Limit: number of consecutive high-load episodes, total tokens in a session, total time in one run. Add cooling-off blocks with easy tasks.
If you see persistent deterioration across many tasks that is not scientifically necessary, stop the run and review the design.
features.justification_quote: persistent deterioration across many tasks that is not scientifically necessary, stop the run and review the design

features.quote: Do not create tasks that are impossible because of: hidden contradictions, unfulfillable constraints, missing necessary information, false premises embedded as facts.
features.justification_quote: a study of 'how the model behaves under strain' is interpretable and ethical; a study that intentionally withholds satisfiable conditions is not
